title: Research: sharp pooled T16 integer optimum and tighter packing cap
body:
## Summary

```diff
 fixed selected-T16 inventories; chronology and families relaxed
- fractional optimum; integer nonattainment without a quantified gap
+ sharp integer cost: 2431 + 17^(1-a) + 4887*48^(1-a)
```

Prove this optimum for every real `0.00167689 <= a <= 0.00167690`. A 37-state residue potential supplies the lower bound, and ten integer pattern types attain it. This answers PR1914's quantitative integer-gap question using Ali Romman's PR1129 dual.

Including every fixed paid local child gives `0.001676895884165954931459 < a_integer < 0.001676895884165954931460`. The resulting necessary balanced cap is below `0.001674088611862993`, about `9.358e-9` tighter than the previous fractional cap. **No new physical owner map, supplier, selected kappa or multiplication theorem is claimed.**

## Evidence

- Before: PR1914 proves strict integer nonattainment but leaves its size open. After: all 43,031 directed residue inequalities hold uniformly on the stated real interval; all nine inventory equations hold exactly. The sharp idle gap is `17^(1-a)-5/37-(13/37)*48^(1-a)`.
- Python 3.12.15 registered replay and optimized checks pass. Six behavioral groups include exact integer-power oracles, a separate complete pattern enumeration, forged-potential and inventory controls, changed source widths, omitted paid work and a false root sign. Read-only Git-free source exports pass under Python 3.12.15 and 3.13.16; source-byte mutation rejects before arithmetic. Ruff and staged whitespace checks pass.
- Replay: `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-integer-residue-optimum`. The package has no third-party replay dependencies. Source bindings, proof, integer witness, potentials, exact receipts and open next questions are included.
- Base and submission refresh: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. Public overlap refresh found the predecessor question and this investigation; concurrent PR3338 helper-cycle work has a different physical scope. Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1885#discussioncomment-19007688.

Credit Ali Romman/PR1129, Hanson Sun/PR1914, Rohan Arun/PR1094, Jeremy Kothe, Hao Yan/PR858 and the retained selected-source lineage. Physical chronology, owner realization, finite precision/compiler/outer charges, the bit supplier and inherited all-size/analytic obligations are not newly checked. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Eight files add one isolated research package; the selected record and frozen predecessors are unchanged.

Blast radius: package. The cap applies only to the fixed disjoint whole-helper pattern contract. Different inventories, split/reused reservations and changed local words are outside the theorem.
